title: DySENSE: Dynamic Spatiotemporal ENergy Synthesis and Emulation with Satellite Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2611.17878v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cities account for over two-thirds of the world's energy and more than 70% of global carbon dioxide emissions. City energy is essential for achieving the 2050 net-zero target and the UN's Sustainable Development Goals 7 and 11. Although existing studies have made progress, they are limited by data and methodological gaps. Existing studies are largely predictive for existing cities rather than generative for future cities; fine-grained, aligned monthly dynamic energy data are scarce; and existing GenAI models struggle to generate dynamic urban functional monthly energy. We present DySENSE, a joint multimodal GenAI framework that synthesizes static urban satellite imagery together with spatially aligned, dynamic monthly building energy consumption maps. translated_title: DySENSE：基于卫星影像的动态时空能源合成与仿真
translated_abstract: 城市消耗了全球超过三分之二的能源，并产生了超过70%的全球二氧化碳排放。城市能源对于实现2050年净零目标以及联合国可持续发展目标7和11至关重要。尽管现有研究已取得进展，但它们受限于数据和方法上的空白。现有研究主要针对已有城市进行预测，而非对未来城市进行生成；细粒度的、空间对齐的月度动态能源数据十分稀缺；且现有生成式AI模型难以生成动态的城市功能月度能源。我们提出了DySENSE，一个联合多模态生成式AI框架，它将静态城市卫星影像与空间对齐的动态月度建筑能耗地图进行合成。我们将长期静态城市形态与短期动态能源消耗解耦。通过以静态城市土地利用为条件，DySENSE可以生成逼真、多样且全新的静态（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: DySENSE提出了一个联合多模态生成式AI框架，通过解耦长期静态城市形态与短期动态能耗，基于卫星影像与土地利用条件生成空间对齐的月度建筑能耗地图，填补了现有研究只能预测已有城市而无法为未来城市生成动态能源数据的空白。
en_tdlr: DySENSE presents a joint multimodal GenAI framework that decouples long-term static urban morphology from short-term dynamic energy consumption, synthesizing satellite imagery with spatially aligned monthly building energy consumption maps to enable generative energy modeling for future cities beyond mere prediction of existing ones.
